contracts.title: Discharge records after admission notifications
contracts.purpose: Find a same-source discharge observation after each patient's first admission notification in the declared index window.
contracts.meaning: An observed notification pair; a pair without encounter identity is provisional. This is not an adjudicated hospital stay.

contracts.title: Admission records after discharge notifications
contracts.purpose: Find an admission observation after each patient's first discharge notification in the declared index window, across contributing sources.
contracts.meaning: An observed admission notification after a discharge notification, not a CMS readmission measure. Missing encounter identity prevents verification of a new stay.

contracts.title: Clinical-date admission observations after discharge
contracts.purpose: Apply the same observation window using explicit clinical event dates only; expose unavailable clinical timing.
contracts.meaning: Explicit clinical timing of received observations. No source-date fallback, verified readmission denominator, planned-admission exclusion or clinical outcome adjudication.
